summary.headline: Planetary Lords and Life Years
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging the lord presiding over a nativity: planetary rays to the Hyleg, the mitigating aspects of benefics, and conditions in angles, houses, dignities, orientation, and sect that determine whether the lord gives greater, middle, or minor years.
